title: TEC Projects Limited - completed acquisition of Tecpak Industries Limited

timeline.event: ACCC commenced review under the Merger Review Process Guidelines.
Closing date for submissions from interested parties.
ACCC announced it would not oppose the completed acquisition.

body_sections.Summary: TEC Projects Limited (TEC Projects) has acquired Tecpak Industries Limited (Tecpak) (the completed acquisition)
body_sections.Market definition: Although the ACCC did not form a concluded view in relation to market definition, it considered whether the completed acquisition would have an impact on competition in any market in Australia for the supply of thin-walled plastic containers.
body_sections.Competition analysis: The ACCC considered that the completed merger was unlikely to result in a substantial lessening of competition in the relevant market. In particular, Tecpak did not appear to be a particularly significant or vigorous and effective competitor in the market and a number of more significant domestic competitors remain.
